trust_decision.summary: The advisory's decision is whether a documentKey (shard key + _id) taken from a change event can be used as a literal equality filter in the updateLookup post-image query. At the pinned commit that decision is already made: dollar-prefixed keys/values are escaped via convertDocumentIntoQuery before lookupSingleDocument. None of the three listed fix commits touches this code. Commit 1 (SERVER-128020) is an unrelated $listCatalog namespace-visibility filter, commit 2 is mutex-stats ordering, and commit 3 is a CI retry.

landing_point.why: lookupLatestPostImage is the updateLookup path named by the summary ('change stream post-image lookups'); it builds the lookup filter from the event's documentKey
